Homer Simpson.description: Homer Jay Simpson is the bumbling patriarch of the Simpson family and Springfield's most famous donut enthusiast.

Marge Simpson.description: Marge Bouvier Simpson is the devoted wife and mother who keeps the Simpson household together with her iconic blue beehive.

Bart Simpson.description: Bartholomew JoJo Simpson is Springfield Elementary's most notorious prankster and skateboard legend.

Lisa Simpson.quote: If anyone wants me, I'll be in my room.
Lisa Simpson.description: Lisa Marie Simpson is the brilliant, saxophone-playing middle child and voice of reason in the Simpson family.

Maggie Simpson.description: Margaret Evelyn Simpson is the youngest Simpson who communicates volumes without saying a word.

Ned Flanders.description: Nedward Flanders Jr. is Homer's impossibly cheerful neighbor and Springfield's most wholesome citizen.

Mr Burns.description: Charles Montgomery Burns is Springfield's oldest and richest resident, eternally plotting to maximize profits.

Milhouse.description: Milhouse Mussolini Van Houten is Bart's best friend and the most unlucky kid in Springfield.
